<Title>Dragon Appearance</>
The Dragon - Projection appears at the <Highlight>center of the Dragon Hunting City Royal City</> <Highlight>10 minutes after</> the start of the Hunting Time on Friday and Sunday nights, which is <Highlight>19:10</>. If it is not repelled before 20:00, the dragon will leave, and no kill settlement will be triggered. 

<Title>Ownership Damage</>
Damage is only counted toward the player's current team if they are alive and dealing damage within <Highlight>40 meters</> of the dragon. When the dragon is repelled, the <Highlight>team with the highest current effective ownership damage</> receives the final ownership and auction rewards. You can view the current ownership damage in real-time after approaching the dragon. 

<Title>Damage Decay</>
After a player dies, leaves the dragon crusade range, switches channels, or leaves the team, the ownership damage that player has accumulated for the team will begin to decay, which will simultaneously affect the team's current effective ownership damage. 

For the <Highlight>first 5 seconds</> after decay is triggered, the ownership damage remains unchanged. Starting from the 6th second, it <Highlight>decreases by 5% of the original accumulated ownership damage every 6 seconds</>, reaching zero after 120 seconds. 

If you re-enter the <Highlight>Dragon Crusade Range</> and resume combat, the decay will stop. The remaining ownership damage will be preserved, and new damage dealt will continue to accumulate on top of this base. 

<Title>Auction Rewards</>
After repelling the dragon, auctions for corresponding tiers will be opened based on the Intense Battle Value. <Highlight>The higher the Intense Battle Value, the higher the tier of auction rewards that can be unlocked</>. 

<Title>Qualification Restrictions</>
In each Hunting Time event, each player can obtain at most <Highlight>1</> qualification for the Dragon - Projection final hunt auction; players who have already obtained the qualification cannot obtain it again during the same event.

       He is fortunate; he met me—the protagonist of this era.

EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Four-Way League】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Mode Description: </><Assistant_System>Four-Way League</> is a large-scale battlefield mode between Clubs. Each match features <Assistant_Red>4 Clubs</> competing on the same field, with each Club fielding up to <Assistant_Red>60 official members</>, totaling <Assistant_Red>240 players</> per match; a single Club can have at most <Assistant_Red>16 people</> of the same Pathway on the field. Each match lasts <Assistant_Red>23 minutes</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Tournament Rules: </>Each round consists of two matches. Before the first match of each round, the 1st and 2nd, 3rd and 4th, 5th and 6th, and 7th and 8th place teams in the group enter different match groups and are randomly assigned under the premise of meeting this rule. The top 2 of each group in the first match enter the Winner's Bracket, and the bottom 2 enter the Loser's Bracket; the second match features Winner's Bracket and Loser's Bracket duels respectively to determine the 1st to 8th place for the round. 
<Assistant_Title2>Win/Loss Rules: </>The Club that reaches <Assistant_Red>3000 points</> first immediately locks in the victory; if no one reaches 3000 points when the match ends, the ranking is based on the current points. If points are tied, <Assistant_Property1>Total Kills</> and <Assistant_Property1>Total Club Beyonder Rating</> are compared in order. 
<Assistant_Title2>In-Match Points: </>The only source of in-match points is the Guardian ownership settlement. Occupying a Guardian for the first time grants <Assistant_Red>50 points</>; during the small settlement every <Assistant_Red>5 seconds</>, each occupied Guardian provides <Assistant_Red>1 point</>; during the large settlement every <Assistant_Red>30 seconds</>, each occupied Guardian provides <Assistant_Red>18 points</>. At the <Assistant_Red>4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 20th minutes</> of the match, a high-multiplier point settlement for Guardian ownership will randomly refresh, providing <Assistant_Red>72 or 108 points</> per occupied Guardian. 
<Assistant_Title2>Strategic Server Screening Points: </>In the first two rounds of the league during the <Assistant_Property1>Strategic Server Screening Phase</>, the Strategic Server Screening Point rules will be enabled. Only Clubs in the <Assistant_Property1>Mythical Group</> can obtain Strategic Server Screening Points. 1st to 4th place in a single match receive <Assistant_Red>30, 15, 10, 5 points</> respectively; 1st to 4th place in the first round receive <Assistant_Red>60, 50, 45, 40 points</> respectively, and 5th to 8th place receive <Assistant_Red>10 points</> each; 1st to 4th place in the second round receive <Assistant_Red>200, 100, 70, 50 points</> respectively, and 5th to 8th place receive <Assistant_Red>15 points</> each. After the first two rounds of the league in the Strategic Server Screening Phase, the top 4 Clubs in the Strategic Server Screening total points in this division will advance to the <Assistant_Property1>Four-Way League Apocalypse Group</> and obtain the qualification to <Assistant_Property1>participate in the Strategic Server</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Tie-breaking: </>Strategic Server Screening rankings are prioritized by <Assistant_Property1>Strategic Server Screening Total Points</> from high to low. When total points are tied: After the first or second round of the league, sorting is based on the Club's <Assistant_Property1>Final Ranking</> in this round, with higher rankings taking precedence; after the first match of each round of the Four-Way League, the final ranking for this round has not yet been generated, so tied Clubs are not distinguished by ranking, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking of this round. 
<Assistant_Title2>Guardian Contention: </>There are <Assistant_Red>5 Guardians</> on the battlefield. The Club that lands the last hit on a Guardian gains control of it; after ownership is established, the Guardian will immediately respawn and belong to that side. Guardians cannot be healed, but will slowly recover Health automatically when there are no enemies nearby. 
<Assistant_Title2>Resources and Command: </>Defeating enemy players or occupying Guardians grants resource points and automatically accumulates Morale level. The President, Vice President, and Councilors can consume resource points to release Command Skills. 
<Assistant_Title2>Command Skills: </><Assistant_Property1>Declaration of Defeating the Enemy</> consumes 1000 resource points, increasing the Suppression of all Pathways for all members by 15% for 20 seconds, with a 180-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Forced March</> consumes 600 resource points, increasing the movement speed of all members by 60% for 10 seconds, with a 120-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Zero-Order Decree</> consumes 1500 resource points, clearing the current resurrection wait for all members and covering members who fall in battle within the next 5 seconds, with a 240-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Summon Teleport</> consumes 2400 resource points, summoning all members to the designated assembly point, with a 240-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Sanctuary Protection</> consumes 1000 resource points, restoring 50% of the maximum Health of all your Guardians, with a 180-second cooldown. 
<Assistant_Title2>Participation Method: </>{JumpToUI:[Go to Four-Way League]|1250063}

CN:
一段时间以来，未成年人过度使用甚至沉迷网络游戏问题突出，对正常生活学习和健康成长造成不良影响，社会各方面特别是广大家长反映强烈。为进一步严格管理措施，坚决防止未成年人沉迷网络游戏，切实保护未成年人身心健康，现将有关要求通知如下。

一、严格限制向未成年人提供网络游戏服务的时间。自本通知施行之日起，所有网络游戏企业仅可在周五、周六、周日和法定节假日每日20时至21时向未成年人提供1小时网络游戏服务，其他时间均不得以任何形式向未成年人提供网络游戏服务。

二、严格落实网络游戏用户账号实名注册和登录要求。所有网络游戏必须接入国家新闻出版署网络游戏防沉迷实名验证系统，所有网络游戏用户必须使用真实有效身份信息进行游戏账号注册并登录网络游戏，网络游戏企业不得以任何形式（含游客体验模式）向未实名注册和登录的用户提供游戏服务。

三、各级出版管理部门加强对网络游戏企业落实提供网络游戏服务时段时长、实名注册和登录、规范付费等情况的监督检查，加大检查频次和力度，对未严格落实的网络游戏企业，依法依规严肃处理。
EN:
For some time, excessive use of and addiction to online games among minors have become serious problems, adversely affecting their normal lives, studies, and healthy development. These concerns have prompted strong public responses, particularly from parents. To further strengthen management, prevent minors from becoming addicted to online games, and protect their physical and mental health, the following requirements are hereby announced.

All online games must connect to the National Press and Publication Administration's real-name verification system for preventing online gaming addiction. All users must register and log in using genuine, valid identity information. Online gaming companies must not provide services in any form, including guest trial modes, to users who have not registered and logged in under their real identities.

III. Publishing authorities at all levels shall strengthen supervision and inspection of online gaming companies' compliance with service hours and duration limits, real-name registration and login, payment practices, and related requirements. Warzone screening points are only obtained during the Four-Way League in the <Highlight> Warzone Screening Period </>. Only Clubs in the <Highlight> Mythical Group </> can earn Strategic Server screening points. During the screening period, Clubs participate in the Four-Way League and accumulate points; after the screening ends, rankings will be based on the cumulative points in this warzone, with the <Highlight> top 4 Clubs advancing to the Strategic Server </>. 
 In each match of the Four-Way League, the first and second place teams enter the Winners' Bracket, while the third and fourth place teams enter the Losers' Bracket; after the second match, the 1st to 8th place for this round are determined based on the match results. 
 Warzone screening points are composed of the cumulative <Highlight> Single-Match Placement Points </> and <Highlight> Final Round Ranking Points </>: 
 <Highlight> Single-Match Placement Points: </> 1st place: 30 points, 2nd place: 15 points, 3rd place: 10 points, 4th place: 5 points. 
 <Highlight> First Round Final Ranking Points: </> 1st place: 60 points, 2nd place: 50 points, 3rd place: 45 points, 4th place: 40 points, 5th to 8th place: 10 points each. 
 <Highlight> Second Round Final Ranking Points: </> 1st place: 200 points, 2nd place: 100 points, 3rd place: 70 points, 4th place: 50 points, 5th to 8th place: 15 points each. 
 <Highlight> Tie-breaking Rules: </> Warzone screening rankings are prioritized by <Highlight> Total Warzone Screening Points </> from highest to lowest. When total points are equal: after the first or second round of the league ends, the ranking is based on the Club's <Highlight> Final Ranking </> in that round, with the higher rank taking priority; after the first match of each Four-Way League round, the final ranking for the round has not yet been determined, so tied Clubs are not distinguished by rank, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking for the round. 
 <Highlight> Additional God-Chosen Seats: </> When the Strategic Server settles, the top three Clubs in the warzone during screening can receive additional God-Chosen Seats: <Highlight> 1st place: 10 seats, 2nd place: 5 seats, 3rd place: 5 seats </>.

EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Hunting City Battle】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description: </><Assistant_System>Hunting City Battle</> is a <Assistant_Red>1000-player</> large-scale battlefield in the Faction War. Battlefield eligibility is assigned at <Assistant_Red>21:20</> after the first match of each Four-Way League round. The system will assign clubs to either the Hunting City Battle or the Highland Battle based on their overall strength. Eligible club members can view the schedule in the <Assistant_System>War-Driven Growth - Faction - Hunting City Battle</> interface. A single club can field a maximum of <Assistant_Red>16 people</> from the same Pathway.
<Assistant_Title2>Phase 1: </>Depart from your <Assistant_Property1>Stronghold</> and advance along <Assistant_Property1>Outposts</> and <Assistant_Property1>Camps</>. After occupying a camp, you can attack the connected <Assistant_Property1>War Stele</>. You must occupy two steles connected to your camp to attack the <Assistant_Property1>Royal City Gate</>; if your stele is captured by the enemy, you lose the eligibility to attack the gate.
<Assistant_Title2>Phase 2: </>After the Royal City Gate is breached, you can proceed to the central platform to occupy the Royal City. The faction with the most people on the platform will accumulate <Assistant_Property1>Occupation Value</>; killing enemy Beyonders on the central platform also increases your faction's Occupation Value. When the Occupation Value reaches <Assistant_Red>100%</>, the Royal City is occupied. Occupying the central Royal City ends the battlefield immediately and grants the final winner's rewards.
<Assistant_Title2>Battlefield Features: </>You can take a <Assistant_Property1>Steam Train</> from your stronghold to quickly reach forward camps, and use <Assistant_Property1>Siege Engines</> when attacking the gate. <Assistant_Property1>War Dragons</> will perch on the central Royal City and appear during the battle.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate: </>{JumpToUI:[Go to Hunting City Battle]|1250322}

EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Final Hunt】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions:</><Assistant_System>Final Hunt</> is a 500-player open-field <Assistant_Red>battle royale</> mode that takes place in the <Assistant_Property1>City of Dragon Hunting</>. You can defeat Beyonder creatures or hostile players to obtain <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> and Rank Points.
<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective:</> Submit <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> to the <Assistant_System>Hunting Butler</> to advance the hunting progress and unlock stage rewards. Scarlet Relics are only effective within the City of Dragon Hunting; they will automatically expire and be cleared upon leaving.
<Assistant_Title2>Hunting Time:</> The mode is available all day; <Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</> daily is Hunting Time, with an additional session on Saturdays and Sundays from <Assistant_Red>14:00—15:00</>. During Hunting Time, the number of Rank Points involved in kills or deaths is doubled.
<Assistant_Title2>Royal City Event:</> 10 minutes after the start of the Hunting Time on Friday and Sunday nights, i.e., at <Assistant_Red>19:10</>, a Dragon - Projection will spawn in the center of the Royal City; outside of the Friday and Sunday night sessions, a Royal City Guardian will spawn 10 minutes after the start of other Hunting Times.
<Assistant_Title2>Team Settlement:</> The killer and up to 29 eligible team members who contributed assists participate in the reward settlement. Scarlet Relics are distributed equally among participants, with any remainder given first to the killer, and the rest distributed randomly among other participants.
<Assistant_Title2>Plunder Rules:</> The more fragments displayed above a player's head, the higher the percentage of Scarlet Relics that can be plundered; for every 500 additional fragments, the plunder percentage increases accordingly.
<Assistant_Title2>Rank Rules:</> When your rank is below <Assistant_Red>Earl Tier 1</>, you will not lose Rank Points upon being killed. Rank Points gained from killing players will decay according to the rules between 01:00—08:00 daily and when killing the same target repeatedly within a short period.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate:</>{JumpToUI:[Go to Final Hunt]|1250342}
